Yes, switching wins 2/3 of the time and staying wins 1/3. Your first pick is right 1/3 of the time, and since the host always opens a goat door, the remaining closed door holds the car in every other case.

This assumes the standard rules: the host knows where the car is, always opens a goat door, and always offers the switch. If the host opens a door at random and it happens to show a goat, switching and staying are both 1/2.
